texts: good. Bevin is typed as a brother and linked to Brindle by the possessive kinship link, and nothing mutual is claimed — right, since "X is Y's brother" does not make Y a brother in return.
good. the tending, its doer and the named lantern (with its kind read off the name itself) are all covered, and the habitual present is correctly left untensed.
good. "the Stilllight station" becomes one named individual carrying a station type atom, and "hard" stays a separate property rather than being fused into an invented "hard station" kind.

good. the sleeping, the sleeper and the daytime slot are all recorded, with no tense forced onto the habitual; "during the day" lands on a plain day time tag, which is the accepted treatment for a named stretch of time.

good. the walk, the named Cove Stair, the evening slot, the once-a-day recurrence and the sunset time are all captured, and "down the Cove Stair" keeps its own preposition rather than being forced into a location.
